gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 472.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following road will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road between R.B.L.s 624 and 252 commencing at its junction with Stanley Village Road, running in a southwesterly direction, then westward, then northwestward and terminating at a point west of R.B.L. 566 as shown coloured pink on the plan No. R.H. 397 signed by Hon. Director of Public Works and dated 30th March, 1953. Proposed Name: CARMEL ROAD. Chinese Version: 佳美道.
